calibration_set.question: If your phone's screen time report was projected on a billboard outside your apartment, what would you change first?
How many people in your life right now would you trust to pack your suitcase for a two-week trip without telling you where you're going?
You get to add one mandatory class to every high school in America. What are you teaching?
What's the last thing you changed your mind about that had a serious consequence?
calibration_set.notes: Cory rewrite. Original: 'that actually cost you something'

calibration_set.question: If your last Google search was published as a newspaper headline, how embarrassed are you on a scale of 1-10?
What one thing will you completely guard against AI changing?
calibration_set.notes: Cory rewrite. Original AI version was passive preference; this has fight/defense energy

calibration_set.question: What's something you pretend to understand that you definitely don't?
calibration_set.notes: Examines meta-beliefs, invites asking if you could be wrong

calibration_set.question: What's the most expensive thing you own that makes you zero dollars?
calibration_set.notes: Rich Dad/Poor Dad tension — vanity vs necessity

calibration_set.question: What's something you keep buying on Amazon that you should probably make by hand?
calibration_set.notes: Cory rewrite. Original: 'mass-producing in your life'. Amazon = concrete noun

calibration_set.question: If AI could perfectly replicate your taste in music, would you let it build every playlist, or does the searching matter?
What's the last thing you built with your hands that you were proud of?
calibration_set.notes: Human, shares a story, asks what is usually not asked

calibration_set.question: What rule do you have for yourself that nobody taught you?
calibration_set.notes: Nature vs nurture — the point at which a person took life into their own hands

patterns_observed.high_scoring: Ask what's never asked. Invite stories. Touch identity/agency. Force self-examination. Have tension/stakes. Multi-layered answers possible.
patterns_observed.low_scoring: Observation exercises. Hypothetical preferences. Too passive. No stakes.
patterns_observed.skip_triggers: Require digging through vast memory — deep not cavernous.
patterns_observed.rewrite_upgrades: Adding consequence, specificity, or a concrete noun (Amazon > mass-producing, serious consequence > cost you something, guard against > would you protect)
